compliance.ageNotice: This page is intended for users aged 18 and older.
compliance.restrictedStates: Some apps listed here are not available in certain Indian states, including Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Tamil Nadu, Odisha, Assam, Nagaland, and Sikkim. This page does not state that any specific app is legal or illegal in your location, so check your state's current regulations before downloading or using any app listed here.
compliance.disclaimer: AllYonoUpdate.com does not host, develop, or operate any of the apps listed in this directory. Every Download button leads directly to the platform's own website, and AllYonoUpdate.com has not independently verified any bonus, code, referral, or reward claim shown on third-party platforms. This directory never uses winning, earning, or real-money promotional language. AllYonoUpdate.com and the apps listed in this directory are not affiliated with SBI YONO or the State Bank of India — "Yono" here refers to the gaming apps listed in this directory, not the SBI banking application.

apps.name: Money Rummy
apps.description: Money Rummy is an upcoming rummy-style app reported to be the 57th platform on the Yono network, expected to join the All Yono directory. AllYonoUpdate.com will record its category, promo-code, and download details once the app is available and can be independently reviewed.

faq.q: Is Money Rummy available to download yet?
faq.a: No. Money Rummy is expected to launch between 8:00–9:00 AM IST on September 9, 2026. This page will be updated with a direct download link once the app is available and can be independently reviewed.

faq.q: Will AllYonoUpdate.com host the Money Rummy APK file?
faq.a: No. AllYonoUpdate.com does not host or operate any APK files. Once available, the Download button will lead directly to Money Rummy's own website, not to a file stored here.

faq.q: Is Money Rummy part of the Yono network?
faq.a: It has been reported to be the 57th platform on the Yono network, a claim made by the app's own operator during pre-launch development of its official tracking site. This has not been independently verified by AllYonoUpdate.com.

faq.q: How can I find out when Money Rummy launches?
faq.a: Join the AllYonoUpdate.com Telegram channel for launch updates, or check back on this page after the scheduled release window.
